items.title: Nepal flood survivors are leaving temporary camps as government delays rehabilitation
items.blurb: Most displaced families have moved into rented rooms or elsewhere as makeshift shelters become uninhabitable and the government delays resettlement and promised financial assistance.

items.title: Three more bodies recovered from Himlung avalanche site
items.blurb: The latest recovery takes the number of bodies found so far to seven, while nine Nepalis remain missing after the September 27 avalanche.

items.title: Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says
items.blurb: The Flydubai flight diverted to Tabuk after the pilots allegedly got into a physical altercation, triggering emergency signals and a major security response in Israel.

items.title: Flood-swollen Marsyangdi river cuts off Upper Manang
items.blurb: A submerged bridge and debris-choked river have blocked the main road to Upper Manang, leaving residents unable to reach Chame.

items.title: Narayani flood leaves Bharatpur school covered in mud
items.blurb: Teachers and students are shovelling out classrooms after four days of rain, and flooding left the school covered in thick silt, with outside help yet to arrive.

items.title: Nepal’s call for climate justice was heard, foreign minister says
items.blurb: Shisir Khanal says the country’s UN engagement strengthened its diplomatic position as it seeks climate finance and reconstruction support after the floods.

items.title: Flood damages iconic Dodhara Chandani suspension footbridge
items.blurb: Damage to the third span of the 1.5-km footbridge has prompted authorities to inspect the structure and warn people against using the affected section.

items.title: At least 23 dead in Thailand floods, Bangkok airport in chaos
items.blurb: Flooding has caused an estimated $367 million in damage across 24 provinces, while Thai Airways cut flights from Bangkok amid severe staffing and baggage disruptions.

items.title: A month after the flood, survivors have nowhere to go, no way to earn
items.blurb: Relief has helped families through the immediate aftermath, but damaged roads, lost homes, closed schools and shattered livelihoods are making recovery harder.

items.title: NDRRMA Chief Upreti on what Nepal must change after the Bhotekoshi disaster
items.blurb: A month after the Bhotekoshi flood, Nepal’s disaster authorities are assessing the damage, planning reconstruction and considering the relocation of settlements in high-risk areas.

items.title: BP Highway reopens after five-day disruption
items.blurb: Traffic resumed Tuesday morning on an under-construction permanent track after floods damaged the highway at eight locations.
